query: topk(500, sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{container!=""}[24h])) / sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{container!=""}[24h])) > 0.001)
why: The same ratio over 24 hours, weighted by the periods each hour ran. The 5-minute value says "now", this one says "through the day"; resources.cpu-throttling fails only on this one and warns on a 5-minute spike alone
